scientific_integrity: Proof uses integral exterior-chain saturation and standard CW homotopy; finite mod-two tests are supporting checks, not proofs. Publication priority is checked against named primary literature and indexed mathematical results, not certified exhaustively.
scientific_limitations: Applies to tolerance t>=2 of strictly one-dimensional unfilled finite simple graph complexes; it does not extend to clique fillings or general higher-dimensional input complexes. The top homology automorphism module is not classified.
title: Integral homotopy and component-lattice classification of higher tolerance complexes of graphs
